name: Engineering and Computing Summer Academy (UNM)
org: University of New Mexico Engineering Student Success Center
what_you_do: Do hands-on work in engineering and computer science. Meet UNM students and STEM faculty. Meet people who work in the field.
grades: Incoming grades 8 to 12 (depends on the option)
who_can_apply: June option: kids going into 8th, 9th or 10th grade. 8th and 9th graders get priority. July option, where you live on campus: kids going into 11th or 12th grade. Students 16 and older get priority. You need a computer at home or time on site for homework.
pay_detail: Tuition, lunches and materials are covered in the June option. Students get a small stipend after finishing. The amount is not stated.
duration: June option: June 1 to 12. July residential option: June 22 to July 17 (2026 dates)
deadline_text: The 2026 priority deadline was March 15, 2026. The page lists no 2027 dates.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application. Add a personal statement of 400 to 500 words. Ask one math or science teacher to email a recommendation. Email your latest unofficial transcript. Packets that are not complete are not accepted.
notes: The page says room and board might be covered for the July residential option. The program page lists a phone number and email for help with the application.
